- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; reduce initial forecast values by 1–2% for 30-day horizon.
- When sentiment is neutral (all 0.00), model exhibits strong downward bias in later days; apply upward adjustment of +0.5–1.5% for days 15–30.
- Overshoots after price spikes (e.g., 71.53 → 72.00) are common; cap forecast peaks at 10% below prior high or 1.5% below recent 5-day average.
- Mean reversion is evident: model often fails to correct downward momentum; add 0.3–0.7% upward bias in mid-forecast (days 10–15) to counteract underestimation.
- If true outcome shows sharp upward move (e.g., +3%+ in 3–5 days), model underreacts; increase forecast slope by 0.1–0.3% per day for next 5 days.
